fun_patches.name: Manual Drop-Breeding overrides Birth Control
fun_patches.description: **Works the same with or without Birth Control: the 50-and-over refusal it lifts is The Lost Children's own, which Birth Control does not change.** When you drop an adult villager onto an adult of the opposite sex, a woman aged 50 or older is no longer refused. It is not a guarantee: the game's usual chances still decide whether the pair gets along and whether a baby is conceived, exactly as for any other couple, so a drop can still fail. Every other rule of the drop is unchanged: a man and a woman, both adults, both alive and well, the woman not already expecting or nursing, and the game's own food and population checks. The game never looks at the Parenting preference on a manual drop, and Parenting skill (the dropped villager's) only changes the chances without ever blocking a drop, so an unchecked preference or no skill never stopped one, with or without this patch. Only the manual drop is changed: villagers pairing up on their own, catch-up, events and Birth Control's own rules stay as they are. Off by default.
behavior_changes: After the stock conception roll succeeds, the pairing handler at VA 0x44F610 (step 12) checks the woman: it returns without calling the pregnancy writer when she is at internal age 1000 (50) or older. The player's drop and villagers pairing up on their own both reach this handler through 0x45D510, so the refusal block at file 0x4F7C8 is re-encoded to skip it only for the drop: when the drop's return address 0x430F63 sits at [esp+0x30] -- the depth the drop's own call chain (0x430F5E -> 0x45D510 -> 0x44FBB0 -> 0x44F610) puts it, because the drop queues step 12 on an emptied queue and the handler runs inside that call -- it continues at the stock accept 0x44F7FF, so she conceives on a passing roll like any other woman. Every other entry runs the stock check unchanged.

Autonomous pairing (0x46044C) queues a walk to the partner before step 12, so its handler runs later from the walk's arrival (0x449380) and never with the drop's call on the stack: an initiating woman of 50 or older is still refused after the stock roll, exactly as stock.
explicit_non_changes: Birth Control's two candidate-scan blocks and its chooser change are not touched and do not overlap this patch.

Every other stock manual-drop rule is unchanged and still refuses the drop: same sex, either villager under internal age 360 (18), either villager dead or ill, a woman already expecting or nursing, and the game's own food and population checks.
The stock Parenting skill-attempt roll and the stock conception roll (RNG(300) against Parenting skill and technology) are unchanged and still decide; a drop can fail at either one.

Autonomous pairing keeps the stock woman-aged-50-or-older refusal in the shared handler; the partner chooser and candidate scans, catch-up, Island Events and every other birth route, the conception and pregnancy writers, delivery, and automatic physical-capacity safety are unchanged.
